'''Derek Mower''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]] on 30 June 2001 with Train to 6, according to Justin Beal's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2578">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-05-collectormania-open-06-30-01d2578/ collectormania-open-06-30-01], DeckTech (Justin "Bubba Joe" Beal, 5 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-05-collectormania-open-06-30-01d2578/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
